title: When the Parish Breaks
author: Astrid Coldharbour
blurb: Marguerite Marchetti, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has spent twenty years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the statute expires.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
